title: Home Oxygen Therapy Claims Posting — Equipment Months Paid in Full by the Coverage
content:
# Posting an Equipment Month Paid in Full — Home Oxygen Therapy

## Situation the rule governs

An equipment month of Home Oxygen Therapy that the coverage paid in full, leaving no patient share because the plan's out-of-pocket maximum was already met, is posted to the oxygen claim history with its allowed amount. The payer's allowed amount is recorded as both the allowed and the paid amount, the patient share is recorded as 0.00, and the paid month counts toward the payment period.

For an equipment month this rule governs, and only for such a month, the month's fee and the allowed amount are the ones this rule fixes; every other equipment month remains under the monthly equipment billing rule of Home Oxygen Therapy for its fee and for its allowed amount.

**An equipment month is posted as paid only after the oxygen record shows the system set up, with its setup date and an active rental.**

Restated: while the oxygen record does not show the system set up with its setup date and an active rental, no equipment month is posted as paid on it.

## The tool: `record_oxygen_equipment_payment_51bbc3fc`

**Capability.** Posts a monthly oxygen equipment claim that the patient's coverage paid in full, leaving nothing for the patient to pay. One call adds one paid equipment-month line to the patient's oxygen claim history; the oxygen claim lookup then shows the new paid line with the values given.

**How it is invoked.** An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `record_oxygen_equipment_payment_51bbc3fc` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format and values |
|---|---|---|
| `oxygen_holding_id` | reference number of the patient's home oxygen record, from the oxygen record lookup | identifier |
| `coverage_id` | reference number of the coverage record that paid the month, from the coverage lookup | identifier |
| `service_from_date` | first day of the equipment month paid | YYYY-MM-DD |
| `adjudication_date` | date of the payer's remittance that paid the month | YYYY-MM-DD |
| `claim_number` | the payer's claim control number for the month, exactly as the patient reads it from the payer's statement | verbatim, character for character |
| `hcpcs_code` | the stationary equipment code billed on the line | `E1390` when the stationary unit is an oxygen concentrator; `E0439` when it is a liquid oxygen reservoir; `E0442` is a liquid contents month and `E0443` a gaseous contents month, which this tool never posts |
| `flow_modifier` | the flow-rate modifier on the line | `QE` when the prescribed flow in force is below the low-flow threshold; `QG` when it is above the high-flow threshold and no portable equipment is billable; `QF` when it is above the high-flow threshold and portable equipment is billable; `none` when the flow sits between the two thresholds |
| `rental_month_number` | ordinal of the equipment month within the payment period | non-negative integer, 1 for the first month |
| `portable_allowed_amount` | the part of the allowed amount that pays the portable add-on | USD, 2 decimal places; 0.00 when no add-on is paid on the month |
| `allowed_amount` | the payer's allowed amount for the whole line | USD, 2 decimal places; stored as given, also as the amount paid |

**Return.** A one-line confirmation "Posted paid-in-full equipment month <`rental_month_number`> (<`service_from_date`>) on oxygen record <`oxygen_holding_id`>: line <line id>, allowed <`allowed_amount`>, paid <`allowed_amount`>, patient share 0.00.", where the line id is the new claim line reference. Its presence means the paid line was added.

## Illustration (hypothetical values)

A call with `rental_month_number` 7, `service_from_date` 2025-09-14 and `allowed_amount` 193.00 returns "Posted paid-in-full equipment month 7 (2025-09-14) on oxygen record ...: line ..., allowed 193.00, paid 193.00, patient share 0.00."
